title: FrugalEvo: Towards Cost-Aware LLM-Guided Program Evolution
title_zh: FrugalEvo: 向成本意识的LLM引导程序进化迈进

paragraphs.en: LLM-guided evolutionary methods, such as AlphaEvolve, have emerged as powerful approaches for challenging computational optimization problems, such as circle packing. However, prior work typically optimizes performance gain over a fixed number of iterations. We argue that practical optimization should maximize gain per unit cost . To this end, we propose FrugalEvo , a cost-aware evolutionary framework where a stronger, higher-cost LLM explores solution strategies, and a cheaper LLM implements them and iteratively refines the resulting code. We also design a cache-efficient evolution process, where our harness and prompts maximize the sharing of prefixes across different evolution steps, to improve cache reuse. To measure solution quality throughout a fixed cost budget, we introduce Budget-Aware Area Under the Curve (BA-AUC), defined as the area under the best-so-far evaluation score curve over cumulative LLM cost, up to the budget. Across 10 mathematical and systems optimization tasks, FrugalEvo matches or surpasses state-of-the-art baselines, including OpenEvolve, ShinkaEvolve, AdaEvolve, and EvoX, in final solution quality and achieves higher BA-AUC on 9 tasks. It also achieves higher average performance than these baselines on 10 algorithmic optimization tasks from ALE-Bench-Lite. Notably, on circle packing, FrugalEvo achieves new state-of-the-art performance with GPT-5.6 Terra and Luna for only $1.68 and with GLM-5.3 and its Flash variant for only $0.55, matching or surpassing all baselines, including multi-agent methods such as CORAL and SwarmResearch, which cost approximately $50 on average.
paragraphs.zh: 由大型语言模型（LLM）引导的演化方法，例如 AlphaEvolve，已成为解决具有挑战性的计算优化问题（如圆堆积问题）的有效手段。 然而，以往的研究通常是在固定次数的迭代中优化性能提升。 我们认为，实用的优化方法应最大化单位成本的收益。 为此，我们提出了 FrugalEvo——一个具备成本意识的演化框架：一个能力更强但成本更高的大型语言模型负责探索解决方案策略，而一个成本更低的大型语言模型则负责执行这些策略并迭代优化生成的代码。 我们还设计了一种缓存高效的演化流程，通过特定的工具调用和提示词，最大化不同演化步骤间前缀的共享程度，从而提升缓存复用效率。 为了在固定成本预算内衡量解决方案的质量，我们引入了“预算感知曲线下面积”（Budget-Aware Area Under the Curve, BA-AUC），其定义为：在累计大型语言模型成本达到预算上限时，最佳当前评估得分曲线下的面积。 在10项数学和系统优化任务中，FrugalEvo 的最终解决方案质量与 OpenEvolve、ShinkaEvolve、AdaEvolve 和 EvoX 等当前最先进的基线方法相当或更优，并在9项任务中实现了更高的 BA-AUC。 在 ALE-Bench-Lite 提供的10项算法优化任务中，其平均性能也优于这些基线方法。 值得注意的是，在圆堆积问题上，FrugalEvo 使用 GPT-5.6 Terra 和 Luna 模型仅花费1.68美元，或使用 GLM-5.3 及其 Flash 变体仅花费0.55美元，便实现了新的最先进水平，与包括 CORAL 和 SwarmResearch 等多智能体方法在内的所有基线方法相当或更优，而这些多智能体方法的平均成本约为50美元。

paragraphs.en: Rapid advances in large language models (LLMs) have accelerated scientific discovery across diverse domains ( Feng et al., 2026b ; Liu et al., 2026a ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . In particular, LLM-guided evolutionary methods, such as AlphaEvolve ( Novikov et al., 2025 ) , OpenEvolve ( Sharma, 2025 ) , and ShinkaEvolve ( Lange et al., 2026 ) , have shown promise in computational optimization problems, including mathematics ( Glazer et al., 2024 ) , systems ( Cheng et al., 2025 ) , and algorithmic optimization ( Imajuku et al., 2026 ) . These methods typically maintain a pool of high-performing programs or solutions; they iteratively select a parent from this pool, prompt an LLM to propose a mutation, and then evaluate the resulting candidate. Progress is often measured as performance after a given number of evolutionary iterations ( Liu et al., 2026b ; Cemri et al., 2026 ) , with curves plotted against the number of LLM-generated candidates or evaluator calls.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）的快速发展加速了多个领域的科学发现（Feng 等，2026b；Liu 等，2026a；Wang 等，2026）。 特别是，由 LLM 引导的演化方法，例如 AlphaEvolve（Novikov 等，2025）、OpenEvolve（Sharma，2025）和 ShinkaEvolve（Lange 等，2026），在计算优化问题中展现出潜力，包括数学（Glazer 等，2024）、系统（Cheng 等，2025）和算法优化（Imajuku 等，2026）。 这些方法通常维护一个高性能程序或解决方案的集合；它们会迭代地从该集合中选择一个父程序，提示 LLM 提出变异，然后评估由此产生的候选方案。 进展通常通过经过一定次数演化迭代后的性能来衡量（Liu 等，2026b；Cemri 等，2026），并将曲线绘制为 LLM 生成的候选方案数量或评估器调用次数的函数。

paragraphs.en: However, focusing on performance after a fixed number of iterations may overlook a key practical constraint in computational optimization: the total cost. This cost may include API fees or GPU compute costs for LLM inference, CPU compute costs for evaluator execution, and other CPU/GPU resource costs associated with task execution. On many challenging tasks, AI agents achieve better performance with more inference-time computation, a phenomenon known as test-time scaling ( Snell et al., 2024 ; Brown et al., 2024 ; Muennighoff et al., 2025 ) . Consequently, higher performance alone does not establish greater efficiency, as it may simply reflect higher expenditure. We therefore argue that methods should be assessed by their performance-cost trade-offs and their ability to maximize solution quality under a fixed cost budget. This shifts the focus from gain per iteration to gain per unit cost . To measure gain per unit cost, we introduce a new metric, Budget-Aware Area Under the Curve (BA-AUC), based on the performance achieved at each cost budget.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，仅关注固定迭代次数后的性能可能会忽视计算优化中的一个关键实际约束：总成本。 该成本可能包括 LLM 推理的 API 费用或 GPU 计算成本、评估器执行的 CPU 计算成本，以及与任务执行相关的其他 CPU/GPU 资源成本。 在许多具有挑战性的任务中，AI 智能体通过增加推理时的计算量可以获得更好的性能，这一现象被称为测试时扩展（Snell et al., 2024；Brown et al., 2024；Muennighoff et al., 2025）。 因此，仅凭更高的性能并不能证明效率更高，因为这可能仅仅反映了更高的支出。 因此我们认为，评估方法时应考虑其性能与成本的权衡关系，以及其在固定成本预算下最大化解决方案质量的能力。 这将焦点从每次迭代的收益转向单位成本的收益。 为了衡量单位成本的收益，我们引入了一种新的指标——预算感知曲线下面积（BA-AUC），该指标基于每个成本预算下实现的性能。

paragraphs.en: Next, we propose FrugalEvo , a cost-aware LLM-guided evolutionary framework for computational optimization. Since LLM inference often accounts for the largest proportion of search costs in this domain, compared with those of evaluator execution and other CPU/GPU operations, we focus on improving the cost efficiency of LLM inference. As shown in Figure 1(a) , FrugalEvo splits candidate program generation into two steps and uses two different models to carry them out: a strong, high-cost LLM explores diverse, promising design strategies, while a weaker, low-cost LLM implements them as executable programs and iteratively refines the resulting code.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，我们提出了 FrugalEvo——一种考虑成本、由大型语言模型（LLM）引导的计算优化进化框架。 由于在该领域中，LLM 推理通常占搜索成本的绝大部分，远超过评估器执行和其他 CPU/GPU 操作的成本，因此我们专注于提升 LLM 推理的成本效率。 如图 1(a) 所示，FrugalEvo 将候选程序生成分为两个步骤，并使用两种不同的模型来执行：一个能力强但成本高的 LLM 负责探索多样化且前景良好的设计策略，而一个能力较弱但成本低的 LLM 则将这些策略转化为可执行程序，并迭代优化生成的代码。

paragraphs.en: Beyond model collaboration, we design a cache-efficient evolution process for FrugalEvo . Inference systems and APIs that support prompt caching can reuse cached key-value (KV) states for identical prompt prefixes, reducing latency and cost. To facilitate this reuse, we design our harness and prompts to maximize the sharing of prefixes across different evolution steps, improving cache reuse.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate FrugalEvo on 20 tasks spanning mathematical, systems, and algorithmic optimization ( Section 3 ). With two model configurations—GPT-5.6 Terra and Luna ( OpenAI, 2026 ) , and GLM-5.3 and its Flash variant ( Z.ai, 2026b ; Z.ai, 2026a ) — FrugalEvo matches or outperforms OpenEvolve ( Sharma, 2025 ) , ShinkaEvolve ( Lange et al., 2026 ) , AdaEvolve ( Cemri et al., 2026 ) , and EvoX ( Liu et al., 2026b ) in final solution quality and BA-AUC on 9 of 10 mathematical and systems optimization tasks. It also achieves the highest average performance across 10 algorithmic optimization tasks and matches or surpasses the reported AlphaEvolve ( Novikov et al., 2025 ) results on all four mathematical tasks with available comparisons. Notably, as shown in Figure 1(b) , FrugalEvo achieves a sum of radii of 2.63599 on Circle Packing using GLM-5.3 and its Flash variant for only $0.55, surpassing all baselines, including multi-agent methods which cost approximately $50 on average. Moreover, Figure 1(c) shows that FrugalEvo substantially reduces the average cost per iteration.

paragraphs.en: We argue that practical LLM-guided evolutionary search in computational optimization should focus on improving performance gain per unit cost. In this work, we introduce Budget-Aware Area Under the Curve (BA-AUC) to assess solution quality throughout a fixed LLM cost budget, complementing evaluation based on final scores.
paragraphs.zh: 我们认为，计算优化中实用的 LLM 引导进化搜索应专注于提升单位成本的性能增益。 在本项工作中，我们提出了“预算感知曲线下面积”（BA-AUC）指标，用于在固定的 LLM 成本预算内评估解决方案的质量，以补充基于最终分数的评估方法。

sents.en: We argue that practical LLM-guided evolutionary search in computational optimization should focus on improving performance gain per unit cost.

sents.en: In this work, we introduce Budget-Aware Area Under the Curve (BA-AUC) to assess solution quality throughout a fixed LLM cost budget, complementing evaluation based on final scores.

paragraphs.en: We propose FrugalEvo , a cost-aware evolutionary framework that combines strategy exploration by a strong, high-cost model with code implementation and refinement by a low-cost model, and design a cache-efficient evolution process.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 FrugalEvo，一种成本感知的进化框架。该框架将强大但高成本的模型用于策略探索，同时由低成本模型负责代码实现与优化，并设计了一种缓存高效的进化流程。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate FrugalEvo on 20 real-world computational optimization tasks. FrugalEvo matches or surpasses all baselines, including OpenEvolve, ShinkaEvolve, AdaEvolve, and EvoX, in solution quality and achieves higher BA-AUC on 9 of 10 mathematical and systems optimization tasks. It also achieves the highest average performance on 10 algorithmic optimization tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 20 个真实世界的计算优化任务上对 FrugalEvo 进行了评估。 在解决方案质量方面，FrugalEvo 与所有基线方法（包括 OpenEvolve、ShinkaEvolve、AdaEvolve 和 EvoX）相当或更优，并在 10 个数学和系统优化任务中的 9 个任务上实现了更高的 BA-AUC。 它在 10 个算法优化任务中也实现了最高的平均性能。

paragraphs.en: The strategy explorer generates design strategies based on a parent program. Using a weak initial program as the parent may lead to low-quality strategies and inefficient use of the cost budget. We therefore introduce a cold-start phase in which a low-cost LLM iteratively refines the initial program until the evaluation score no longer improves. The best resulting program becomes the initial incumbent and serves as the parent for the first round of strategy exploration.
paragraphs.zh: 策略探索器基于一个父程序生成设计策略。 使用较弱的初始程序作为父程序，可能导致生成的策略质量较低，并且无法有效利用成本预算。 因此，我们引入一个冷启动阶段，在此期间，一个低成本的大语言模型会迭代优化初始程序，直到评估分数不再提升。 最终产生的最佳程序将成为初始的当前最优解，并作为第一轮策略探索的父程序。

paragraphs.en: The context builder organizes task information and search history to guide strategy exploration. At the start of evolution, the context builder uses a high-cost LLM to analyze the problem description and evaluator code to identify the optimization objective and evaluation constraints. It combines this information with the incumbent program established by cold start and its evaluation feedback to construct the initial search context. As the search progresses, it updates the context with the latest incumbent and attempted programs, strategies, and evaluation feedback retrieved from the search memory, guiding subsequent strategy exploration.

paragraphs.en: Specifically, to reduce input-token costs, we construct cache-efficient prompts by placing shared content at the beginning, enabling prefix reuse through API prompt caching. 1 1 1 A couple of LLM API providers support prompt caching, allowing repeated prompt prefixes to be reused at a lower input-token cost; e.g., OpenAI: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/prompt-caching . To maximize prefix reuse between attempts, each prompt begins with fixed content (task instructions, output requirements, etc.). This is followed by information which changes less frequently, e.g., contextual examples, with island-best and elite programs appearing first before randomly sampled programs, lastly followed by frequently changing information, preserving the maximum amount of shared prefix across successive attempts. Additionally, feedback from each attempt is appended to the end of the prompt, allowing cache usage.
paragraphs.zh: 具体来说，为了降低输入令牌成本，我们通过将共享内容置于开头来构建缓存高效的提示，从而通过 API 提示缓存实现前缀重用。1 1 1 有几家 LLM API 提供商支持提示缓存，这使得重复使用的提示前缀能够以较低的输入令牌成本被重用；例如，OpenAI：https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/prompt-caching 。 为了在每次尝试之间最大化前缀的重用，每个提示都以固定内容（任务说明、输出要求等）开头。 接下来是变化较少频率的信息，例如上下文示例，其中岛屿最佳和精英程序首先出现，随后是随机采样的程序，最后才是频繁变化的信息，从而在连续尝试中保留尽可能多的共享前缀。 此外，每次尝试的反馈都会被附加到提示的末尾，以便利用缓存。

paragraphs.en: Since algorithmic design can substantially affect solution quality, we use a strong, high-cost LLM to explore diverse design strategies. Given the search context, including the parent program, evaluation feedback, and previously explored strategies, it proposes multiple distinct strategies in a single API call. Each strategy provides a concrete plan for modifying the parent program, explaining what to change, why it may improve performance, and what computational limits to follow. The proposed strategies are then passed to the solution generator for implementation and refinement.
paragraphs.zh: 由于算法设计会显著影响解决方案的质量，我们使用一个功能强大但成本高昂的大型语言模型（LLM）来探索多样化的设计策略。 在给定搜索上下文（包括父程序、评估反馈以及之前探索过的策略）的情况下，该模型在一次 API 调用中提出多种不同的策略。 每种策略都提供了一份具体的父程序修改方案，说明了需要更改什么、为何可能提升性能，以及应遵循哪些计算限制。 随后，所提出的策略会被传递给解决方案生成器，以进行实现和优化。

It first generates one trial implementation per strategy and ranks the strategies by their evaluation scores. It then follows this ranking to select strategies for further refinement. Each refinement round fixes one strategy and the current incumbent as the parent program, allowing up to M M sequential implementation attempts. Each attempt is evaluated, and feedback from unsuccessful attempts informs subsequent prompts while the parent remains unchanged. As soon as an attempt improves the incumbent, the round ends, the improved program becomes the new incumbent, and another round begins with the same strategy and the updated parent. If a round ends without improvement, the generator moves to the next strategy.
paragraphs.zh: 解决方案生成器使用低成本的大语言模型来实现和优化所提出的策略。 它首先为每种策略生成一次试验性实现，并根据评估分数对策略进行排序。 然后，它按照这一排序选择策略进行进一步优化。 每次优化轮次会固定一种策略和当前的最优方案作为父程序，最多允许 M 次连续的实现尝试。 每次尝试都会被评估，而失败尝试的反馈将用于指导后续提示，同时父程序保持不变。 一旦某次尝试提升了当前最优方案，该轮次即结束，优化后的程序将成为新的最优方案，随后以相同的策略和更新后的父程序开始新一轮优化。 如果一轮次结束仍未取得改进，生成器将转向下一个策略。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate five tasks spanning geometric packing, extremal geometry, distance-ratio minimization, and multi-objective signal filtering. As shown in Table 1 , FrugalEvo achieves the highest mean BA-AUC on all five tasks under both model configurations. It also achieves the best or comparable mean performance on all five tasks using GPT-5.6 Terra and Luna and four using GLM-5.3 and the Flash variant. Compared to the strong reported results in the closed-source AlphaEvolve, FrugalEvo matches or exceeds AlphaEvolve on four tasks, including Circle Packing , Heilbronn Convex (13) , Heilbronn Triangle , and Min-Max-3 .

paragraphs.en: Beyond aggregate scores, FrugalEvo discovers qualitatively distinct solutions across different tasks. On Circle Packing , it finds a packing with a total radius of 2.635996 by evolving five-row layouts with asymmetric displacements, refining them through constrained SLSQP optimization and fixed-center radius linear programming, and applying small radius increases within the evaluator’s tolerance.
paragraphs.zh: 除了综合得分之外，FrugalEvo 还能在不同任务中发现性质上截然不同的解决方案。 在圆堆积问题上，它通过演化具有非对称位移的五行布局，利用受约束的 SLSQP 优化和固定中心半径的线性规划对其进行优化，并在评估器的容限范围内逐步增加小半径，最终找到了一个总半径为 2.635996 的堆积方案。

paragraphs.en: Qualitatively, FrugalEvo discovers effective approaches to systems optimization. On EPLB , it achieves a score of 0.1473 with an expert load-balancing algorithm that combines greedy expert replication, load-aware block assignment, and pairwise swap refinement. On Transaction Scheduling , it achieves a combined score of 4405.29 with a scheduler that combines multistart regret-guided insertion, exhaustive local window reordering, and transaction relocation to reduce makespan.

paragraphs.en: Our framework assigns strategy exploration and solution generation to different models to improve search efficiency. As shown in Table 3 , using either the high-cost or low-cost model for both stages yields lower mean and best performance than FrugalEvo on both tasks under the same cost budget. In particular, using only the high-cost model leads to a larger drop in mean performance, possibly because implementation calls consume a substantial portion of the budget, leaving less for further exploration. Moreover, using only the low-cost model reduces the best final score, particularly on Signal Processing . This may be because the low-cost model is less effective at identifying promising strategies. These results suggest that combining strategy exploration by a strong, expensive model with low-cost code implementation improves search efficiency under a fixed cost budget.

paragraphs.en: We introduce a cold-start phase to provide a stronger initial incumbent for strategy exploration. As shown in Table 3 , removing this phase and using the initial program directly as the parent reduces both mean and best performance on both tasks. This suggests that refining the initial program with a low-cost model is a cost-effective way to support high-quality strategy exploration. Moreover, we also incorporate sequential feedback into code refinement in the solution generator. Removing this feedback lowers mean performance and increases the standard deviation across runs, suggesting that feedback from earlier attempts helps the low-cost model refine programs more effectively and improves search stability.

paragraphs.en: Recent work combining LLMs with evolutionary search has produced notable results ( Agrawal et al., 2026 ; Novikov et al., 2025 ) for mathematical ( Feng et al., 2026c ; Feng et al., 2026d ; Feng et al., 2026b ) , algorithmic ( Mang et al., 2025 ) , and systems ( Cheng et al., 2025 ) optimization. For example, FunSearch ( Romera-Paredes et al., 2024 ) combines LLM generation with automated evaluation to evolve mathematical solutions. AlphaEvolve ( Novikov et al., 2025 ) extends this approach from evolving individual functions to larger programs. Subsequently, OpenEvolve ( Sharma, 2025 ) and CodeEvolve ( Assumpção et al., 2025 ) provide open-source frameworks, and ShinkaEvolve ( Lange et al., 2026 ) introduces a sample-efficient evolution method. ThetaEvolve ( Wang et al., 2025 ) and TTT-Discover ( Yuksekgonul et al., 2026 ) apply Reinforcement Learning (RL) to improve the LLM generator at test time. More recently, AdaEvolve ( Cemri et al., 2026 ) and EvoX ( Liu et al., 2026b ) adapt the search process, while SwarmResearch ( Virk et al., 2026 ) and CORAL ( Qu et al., 2026 ) coordinate multiple coding agents to improve search performance. These methods focus on performance gains over a fixed number of iterations, while our work emphasizes gain per unit cost.
paragraphs.zh: 近期将大型语言模型（LLM）与进化搜索相结合的研究，在数学（Feng et al., 2026c; Feng et al., 2026d; Feng et al., 2026b）、算法（Mang et al., 2025）和系统（Cheng et al., 2025）优化领域取得了显著成果（Agrawal et al., 2026; Novikov et al., 2025）。 例如，FunSearch（Romera-Paredes et al., 2024）将LLM生成与自动化评估相结合，以进化出数学解决方案。 AlphaEvolve（Novikov et al., 2025）将这一方法从进化单个函数扩展到了更复杂的程序。 随后，OpenEvolve（Sharma, 2025）和CodeEvolve（Assumpção et al., 2025）提供了开源框架，而ShinkaEvolve（Lange et al., 2026）则引入了一种样本效率更高的进化方法。 ThetaEvolve（Wang et al., 2025）和TTT-Discover（Yuksekgonul et al., 2026）应用强化学习（RL）来在测试阶段提升LLM生成器的性能。 近期，AdaEvolve（Cemri et al., 2026）和EvoX（Liu et al., 2026b）对搜索过程进行了调整，而SwarmResearch（Virk et al., 2026）和CORAL（Qu et al., 2026）则通过协调多个编码智能体来提升搜索性能。 这些方法关注在固定迭代次数内的性能提升，而我们的工作则强调单位成本带来的收益。

paragraphs.en: Prior work explores LLM cascades ( Chen et al., 2023 ) , routing ( Ong et al., 2025 ; Feng et al., 2026a ) , reflection ( Agrawal et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) , and caching ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) to improve cost efficiency. For instance, FrugalGPT ( Chen et al., 2023 ) learns model cascades to balance cost and accuracy, while RouteLLM ( Ong et al., 2025 ) learns to route queries between strong and weak models using preference data. For scientific discovery, SimpleTES ( Ye et al., 2026 ) post-trains an open-source model for long-horizon AI discovery by assigning each attempt the final outcome of the trajectory it helped produce. Meanwhile, Squeeze Evolve ( Maheswaran et al., 2026 ) coordinates multiple models for verifier-free evolution using models’ own confidence signals, such as token log-probabilities. Our approach allocates model capability based on the characteristics of computational optimization tasks, without additional model training or access to token-level probabilities.

paragraphs.en: We introduce FrugalEvo , a cost-aware LLM-guided evolutionary framework for computational optimization, that combines strategy exploration by a strong, high-cost model with code implementation and refinement by a low-cost model, and design a cache-efficient evolution process. To assess solution quality throughout a fixed cost budget, we propose Budget-Aware Area Under the Curve (BA-AUC). Across diverse real-world computational optimization tasks, FrugalEvo matches or surpasses all baselines in solution quality and achieves higher BA-AUC on the majority of tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 FrugalEvo——一种面向计算优化的、兼顾成本的 LLM 引导进化框架。该框架将强大但高成本模型的策略探索，与低成本模型实现的代码生成和精炼相结合，并设计了一种缓存高效的进化流程。 为了在固定成本预算下评估解决方案的质量，我们提出了“预算感知曲线下面积”（Budget-Aware Area Under the Curve，BA-AUC）指标。 在多种多样的真实世界计算优化任务中，FrugalEvo 的解决方案质量与所有基线模型相当甚至更优，并且在大多数任务中实现了更高的 BA-AUC 值。

sents.en: Across diverse real-world computational optimization tasks, FrugalEvo matches or surpasses all baselines in solution quality and achieves higher BA-AUC on the majority of tasks.
sents.zh: 在多种多样的真实世界计算优化任务中，FrugalEvo 的解决方案质量与所有基线模型相当甚至更优，并且在大多数任务中实现了更高的 BA-AUC 值。

paragraphs.en: FrugalEvo splits candidate program generation in computational optimization tasks into two steps and assigns them to two different models. This design is tailored to settings where both solution generation and evaluation take place entirely within a code environment, so that candidates can be executed and scored automatically. As a result, our method does not readily extend to scientific domains that require interaction with the physical world, such as biology, where evaluating a solution may involve wet-lab experiments that cannot be automated through code execution. Moreover, guiding the model to explore effective strategies relies on carefully crafted instructions. Our current instructions are manually designed for computational optimization tasks rather than automatically derived from each task. Finally, future work includes extending this approach to other domains that require interaction with the physical world, and develop methods that automatically generate strategy exploration instructions.
paragraphs.zh: FrugalEvo 将计算优化任务中的候选程序生成过程分为两个步骤，并将其分配给两个不同的模型。 这种设计专为解决方案的生成与评估均完全在代码环境中进行的场景而定制，从而能够自动执行并评分候选程序。 因此，我们的方法难以直接扩展到需要与物理世界交互的科学领域（例如生物学），因为在这些领域中，评估解决方案可能涉及无法通过代码执行自动化的湿实验室实验。 此外，引导模型探索有效策略依赖于精心设计的指令。 我们当前的指令是为计算优化任务手动设计的，而非从每个任务中自动推导得出。 最后，未来的工作包括将这种方法扩展到需要与物理世界交互的其他领域，并开发能够自动生成策略探索指令的方法。
